participant_id.Description: sub-<3-digit source patient number>. The HFO files number patients with the same numbers as the atlas: 1086 of 1152 HFO channel names (anode contact) match a channel name of the same patient in the atlas, in 70 of 71 patients.

source_patient_id.Description: Patient number exactly as in the source (Patient variable / PatientInformation.csv ID).

age.Description: Age at time of study (source PatientInformation.csv)

site_code.Description: First character of the source channel names (recording-centre code; power line 50 Hz for G, 60 Hz for M and N per source readme). The source does not name the centres.
